correctness.rationale: The exact six-coordinate model V(e1,e4) in P5 has char-3 translation invariance along 1=(1,...,1) on V={sum x_i=0}, since e4(x+t1)-e4(x)=3te3+6t²e2+10t³e1+15t⁴, all zero on V. This identifies a projective cone with vertex E over quartic S⊂P(V/k1)=P3. Independently built the affine chart g=e4(1,a,b,c,-1-a-b-c) modulo three and its Jacobian ideal. A fresh exact lex Groebner basis has nine standard monomials and the nine distinct F3 solutions listed in RESULT.md, each Hessian determinant 1 mod3. Thus the geometric chart singular scheme has length nine and is reduced, not merely nine rational points; five-coordinate symmetry exhausts exactly 15 pair-difference nodes on S, all A1. No repeated/reducible surface can have an isolated singular set, giving integral normal S; the cone is integral normal by S2 and R1 since 15 singular ruling lines have codimension two. Cone projection gives transverse A1 away from E, and its quartic equation gives multiplicity four at E. This does NOT determine embedded/nonreduced Jacobian structure at the vertex or stable reduction.
